title: 電気設計
subtitle: Designing Skills in Electrical Engineering
teachers:
YANAGIBASHI Hideyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Many electrical equipment that support the functions of modern society are manufactured through electrical design. The definition of design is that producing the electrical equipment most economically and within the deadline, while determining the specifications to be realized and satisfying the given technical requirements, its size, shape. In this course, you will learn about both the concept of the design method and drawing by CAD through lectures and exercises.
advice:
In this course, you will learn the following items in order.

1. Fundamentals of design
2. Structure, principle and basic theory of synchronous machine
3. The nature and content of electrical equipment
4. Basic principles of electrical design
5. Design method of three-phase synchronous generator
6. Design exercise of three-phase synchronous generator
7. CAD drafting basics
8. CAD drafting exercises
requiredKnowledge:
"Electrical equipment I, II" should be completed, because the example of design exercise is three-phase synchronous generator.
"Electrical drafting" should be completed, because the item of CAD drafting exercised is included.

activityGoals.body: You can explain the objective of design technology.
You can explain the purpose and types of standards for design.
You can explain design flow and understand the basic principles of electrical equipment.
You can understand the design method of synchronous machine and can design following the design method.
You can design simple drawing using CAD drafting.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1. You can explain the objective of design technology in detail.
2. You can explain the objective and type of the standards for design in detail.
3. You understand deeply the basic principles of electrical equipment design, and you can explain the design flow in detail.
4. You understand deeply the design method of synchronous machine, and you can design at your will.
5. You can draw CAD drafting at your will.
achievementLevels.standard: The above action goals can be achieved.
